# n8n workflow automation playbook for document pipelines

Curated by Skill Harbor — @claude-office-skills' n8n workflow-automation skill for document pipelines: n8n fundamentals (node-based Trigger → Action → Output with data flowing between nodes), a node-type table (triggers like webhook/schedule/file watcher, document nodes like read-PDF/write-DOCX/OCR, transform nodes, output nodes like email/Slack/Google Drive), and a worked contract-review pipeline (watch a folder for new contracts → extract text → AI review with a Claude prompt → save the report → notify the team on Slack). Includes a self-hosted vs cloud comparison (self-hosted: free, full control, data privacy, maintenance required; cloud: no setup, auto-updates, costs at scale) with a Docker quick start (`n8nio/n8n`), plus best practices (start from the 7 800+ community templates then customize, error-handling nodes for reliability, store credentials in n8n's credential manager, test with sample data before production). Honest caveats: AI nodes need your own LLM API keys (kept in the vault, never pasted into workflows); n8n Cloud is billed at scale — self-hosting is the free path; works in English and Chinese. MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
